verdict.rationale: Twenty's API docs say API keys can be scoped to a specific role (Settings → Members → Roles → Assignment) to limit what they can access. Those roles enforce RBAC down to objects, fields and individual records, and roles can also be assigned to AI agents so they act only within that permission model. Missing for 10: details on the key lifecycle (expiry, rotation, revocation), clarity on whether row-level permissions are limited to certain plans, documentation framing scoped keys specifically for external agents, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
